name: hol-language-server
description: Starts the hol-language-server language server over .ml and .hl files: completion, hover, Go to Definition, and symbols

holLanguageServer.command.description: The language server command: a name on PATH or an absolute path.

holLanguageServer.args.markdownDescription: Flags passed straight to the server. In the Settings UI, click **Add Item** once per flag or value (e.g. `--hol-path`, then `/path/to/hol-light` as a separate item). In `settings.json`: `"holLanguageServer.args": ["--hol-path", "/path/to/hol-light"]`. New server flags work without updating the extension.
